tuning_key.text: There is a presence on the other side / Steering the tide toward a goal worth pride
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: You are being steered toward a worth you cannot see, and this is enough. Let the static be bare; the presence holds the line even when your hands fall from the wheel.

practice.title: Admit the Bare Pulse
practice.instruction: Feel the raw signal in your body exactly as it arrives, without commanding it to change.

practice.title: Release the Wheel
practice.instruction: Soften your grip on any direction or performance, allowing the tide to carry you.

practice.title: Press Play
practice.instruction: Open the Echo audio and let the presence hold the line while you simply receive.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Trust that the systems hold even when you're not watching. Broadcast your coordination as evidence that the unseen presence steers through the mundane, transmitting that infrastructure serves the tide toward goals worth pride. The Field responds with confirmation that operations remain alive in the gaps between your interventions.

The raw signal manifests when pricing and sourcing reveal themselves as part of the tide.
